ev.q: A co-op, roguelike action role-playing game
The game's endings can differ widely depending on the choices the characters make
The story of the game is non-linear, and changes depending on the actions of players
The areas of the game are procedurally generated and will differ for each playthrough
criticized the short length and lack of combat depth
the gameplay is unbalanced with repetitive and "overpowered" moves
calling the game's writing "gorgeous" and the world "atmospheric"
